headlines.title: 美국채 발 고금리에 커지는 재정압박 ...추경 전망치 0.04%P 넘어
headlines.summary: 국고채 조달금리 상승 금리 0.1%P 상승땐 이자만 2200억 ↑ 미국 국채 고금리 여파로 국내 채권 금리가 치솟으면서 정부의 국고채 이자 상환 부담도 커지고 있다. 국고채 평균 조달금리가 지난해 연간 2.66%에서 올해 3.44%로 치솟으면서 재정압박이 더욱 심해지고 있는 것이다. 국고채 조달금리가 정부가 제시한 3.

headlines.title: 이란 전쟁 불확실성 에 美 국채금리 급등…AI 기술주 랠리 '경고등'
headlines.summary: 이란 전쟁을 둘러싼 불확실성에 미국 국채 금리가 급등했다. 지난 15일 막을 내린 미국과 중국의 정상회담에서도 이렇다 할 이란전쟁의 해결책이 나오지 않자 시장의 불안감이 커진 결과다. 국제 유가 상승과 인플레이션(물가상승)에 대한 우려가 긴축적 통화정책에 대한 긴장감을 높였다.

headlines.title: 국채금리 發 쇼크 …‘ 롤러코스피 ’
headlines.summary: 5월 하루평균 337.26포인트 출렁 미국채 30년물 5% 돌파 악재 겹쳐 2거래일 연속 장중 매도 사이드카 코스피 지수가 장중 8000선을 돌파한 지 단 1거래일 만에 장중 7100선까지 밀렸다. 이후 이재명 대통령의 삼성전자 관련 발언 이후 급등, 상승전환하는 등 극심한 변동성을 보였다.

headlines.title: 美국채금리 급등에 韓 ‘ 금리·환율 · 증시 ’ 요동
headlines.summary: 통화긴축기 韓 금리변동 58%가 美서 비롯 韓 30년 국채도 4% 넘겨, 대출금리도↑ ‘경기둔화·차익실현’ 외인 자금이탈 우려 미국 국채금리가 19년 만에 최고 수준으로 치솟으면서 한국 경제도 금리·환율·증시 등 전방위적인 영향이 불가피할 전망이다. 미국 국채 금리 상승은 한국 국채 금리 상승 압력으로 이어져 기업과 가계의 자금 조달 부담을 키운다.

headlines.title: 주담대 금리 상단 7% 넘어 … ‘영끌족’ 이자 부담 커진다
headlines.summary: 5대 은행 年 4.45%∼7.05% 금융채 5년물도 2년만에 최고 미국 채권금리 급등이 국내 시중은행 주택담보대출 금리를 끌어올리는 ‘나비효과’가 본격적으로 나타나고 있다. 국내 금융채와 코픽스가 동시에 올라 고정·변동금리 모두 상승 압박을 받고 있다. 18일 금융계에 따르면, 금융채(은행채 무보증 AAA) 5년물은 지난 15일 4.279%까지 올랐다.

headlines.title: ‘ 팔 집도, 살 집도 없다 ’ 매물 6000건 급감
headlines.summary: 정부 ‘세 낀 집’ 출회 유도에도 매물 증발 집주인 “더 오른다” 관망세, 물건 회수 매물 잠김 심화에 성북·서대문도 상승세 대출 규제에 15억 이하 아파트 수요집중 정부가 토지거래허가구역에서 주택 매수자에게 적용되는 실거주 의무를 세입자가 있는 모든 주택을 대상으로 한시 유예한다고 발표한 12일 서울 강남구 한 부동산 중개업소의 모습.  [연합] #.

headlines.title: 닭살 돋는 물가 … ‘ 삼계탕 2만원 ’ 시대
headlines.summary: 수삼 58%·찹쌀 30%·닭 16% ↑ 초복 두 달 앞두고 보양식 부담 여름철 대표 보양식인 삼계탕의 원재료 값이 일제히 폭등하면서 올해 ‘삼계탕 2만 원 시대’가 열릴 것으로 보인다. 초복(7월 15일)을 두 달여 앞두고 여름 외식 메뉴 가격이 줄줄이 오르면서 소비자 부담이 커지고 있다.

headlines.title: 카카오페이, ' 2차 고유가 피해지원금' 신청 접수 시작
headlines.summary: 카카오페이 카카오페이가 18일부터 '2차 고유가 피해지원금' 신청 서비스를 본격 시작한다. 전국민의 70%가 신청 대상자로 대상자는 1인당 10~60만원을 지원받는다. 카카오페이는 별도의 앱 설치나 전용 카드 발급이라는 번거로움 없이, 전 국민이 사용하는 카카오톡을 통해 신청 프로세스를 일원화했다.

headlines.title: 李대통령, 삼성 파업 앞두고 “ 노동권만큼 기업 경영권 존중돼야 ”
headlines.summary: 이재명 대통령이 지난 14일 청와대에서 열린 수석보좌관회의에서 발언하고 있다. 연합뉴스 이재명 대통령은 18일 “자유민주적 기본질서와 자본주의적 시장경제질서를 채택한 대한민국에서는 기업만큼 노동도 존중돼야 하고, 노동권만큼 기업경영권도 존중돼야 한다”고 밝혔다. 삼성전자 노동조합의 파업을 두고 발언한 것으로 보인다.

핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

오늘 한국 경제는 대내외 불확실성이 동시에 부각되며 긴장감이 높아진 하루였다. 원/달러 환율이 1,500원을 돌파하는 등 원화 약세가 심화되는 가운데, 과거 위안화와의 동조화가 환율 안정에 도움이 됐던 시기를 되돌아보는 시각도 나오고 있다. 채권 시장에서는 한동안 잠잠했던 금리가 다시 움직이기 시작하면서 시장 참여자들의 경계심이 높아지고 있다. 여기에 삼성전자 노사 갈등이 격화되자 청와대가 긴급조정을 정부의 공식 입장으로 밝히며 직접 개입 의지를 드러낸 점도 주목된다. 환율 불안, 금리 변동성 확대, 대기업 노사 리스크가 한꺼번에 맞물리면서 금융시장과 실물경제 모두에 부담이 가중되는 형국이다.

top5_headlines.summary: 5대 은행 年 4.45%∼7.05% 금융채 5년물도 2년만에 최고 미국 채권금리 급등이 국내 시중은행 주택담보대출 금리를 끌어올리는 ‘나비효과’가 본격적으로 나타나고 있다. 국내 금융채와 코픽스가 동시에 올라 고정·변동금리 모두 상승 압박을 받고 있다. 18일 금융계에 따르면, 금융채(은행채 무보증 AAA) 5년물은 지난 15일 4.279%까지 올랐다.

key_headlines.title: Samsung Labor Strike Could Reduce Korea's Growth Rate by 0.5 Percentage Points
key_headlines.summary: The Bank of Korea warned that a total strike by Samsung Electronics' labor union could lower South Korea's economic growth rate by up to 0.5 percentage points this year. The government announced official support for emergency adjustments to resolve labor-management conflicts.

key_headlines.title: Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Exceeds 1,500 Won amid Global Rate Pressures
key_headlines.summary: The won-dollar exchange rate surpassed 1,500 won for consecutive days as US Treasury bond yields surged to 2007 financial crisis levels, driven by Middle Eastern geopolitical tensions and expectations of prolonged high US interest rates.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Reaches 8,000 Amid Semiconductor Super Cycle
key_headlines.summary: The KOSPI index surpassed 8,000 points on the back of a semiconductor super cycle, with total market capitalization approaching the sum of Seoul residential property values. Experts debate whether the index can break through this psychological threshold.

key_headlines.title: US Treasury Rate Hike Creates Fiscal Pressure; South Korea's Sovereign Debt Interest Burden Increases
key_headlines.summary: Rising US Treasury yields are pushing up South Korea's sovereign bond issuance rates from 2.66% last year to 3.44% this year, significantly increasing the government's fiscal burden. A 0.1% rate increase results in an additional 220 billion won in interest payments.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Market Shows Triple-Strength: Simultaneous Rises in Sales, Jeonse, and Monthly Rent
key_headlines.summary: Seoul's apartment market is entering a 'triple strength' phase with simultaneous increases in purchase prices, jeonse (long-term deposit leases), and monthly rents, reflecting severe supply shortages unseen in five years as multi-property owners withdraw inventory.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy faces a critical juncture with the won-dollar exchange rate breaching 1,500 won and KOSPI reaching 8,000 points on semiconductor strength. However, Samsung Electronics' potential labor strike threatens to reduce GDP growth by 0.5 percentage points, while US Treasury yield spikes create mounting fiscal pressures. The government has pledged comprehensive support to resolve labor disputes and manage macroeconomic risks. Real estate markets are simultaneously strengthening across purchase, jeonse, and rental segments due to supply constraints. Economic growth accelerated to 1.7% in the first quarter, the fastest pace in five and a half years, driven by semiconductor recovery and export momentum.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's first-quarter GDP growth reached 1.7% quarter-on-quarter, marking the fastest pace in five and a half years amid semiconductor recovery and strong exports. However, concerns about jobless growth persist, with youth unemployment in their 30s remaining above 3% for five consecutive months. Rising US Treasury yields are transmitting into Korea's sovereign debt market, pushing issuance rates to 3.44% from last year's 2.66%, significantly increasing interest payment burdens. The Bank of Korea warned of potential 0.5 percentage point growth reduction if Samsung's labor strike materializes. Market analysts increasingly emphasize inflation management importance as economic headwinds appear to ease.
sections.Financial Markets: US Treasury yields surged to 2007 financial crisis levels, exceeding 5.1% on 30-year bonds amid Middle East geopolitical tensions and inflation concerns, pressuring global financial markets. The won-dollar exchange rate has surpassed 1,500 won for consecutive days as capital flows respond to rate differentials, triggering foreign investor outflows from Korean equities that exceeded 100 trillion won in cumulative sales. Domestic government bond yields reached two and a half-year highs, with 10-year yields approaching 4% amid external rate pressures. US equity markets showed mixed performance as investors weighed Middle East risks against corporate earnings, with technology stocks under particular pressure from bond yield increases.
sections.Industry & Technology: Semiconductor stocks, particularly Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, led market recovery, offsetting broader market weakness from program sell-offs that briefly triggered trading halts. The AI semiconductor rally continues to drive semiconductor sector momentum, contrasting sharply with weakness in automotive, battery, and other non-semiconductor industrial stocks. LG Electronics and Hyundai Motor experienced sharp declines as high-rate environment impacts companies with significant debt burdens. Industry experts argue that Korea must focus concentrated investment on globally competitive advanced sectors including AI, semiconductors, and next-generation technologies rather than maintaining traditional company size distinctions. Security-related assets including semiconductors, defense, and nuclear energy stocks are gaining investor attention as strategic importance increases.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment market is experiencing unprecedented simultaneous strength across purchase prices, jeonse deposits, and monthly rents, representing a rare 'triple strength' phase driven by severe inventory shortages. Multi-property seller withdrawals following the May 9 capital gains tax changes have sharply reduced available inventory, with cumulative price increases reaching 3.10% year-to-date, double the prior year's pace. The jeonse supply index hit 113.7 as of May 11, the highest level in five years and two months, indicating acute demand-supply imbalance. Young millennials and first-time buyers face elevated entry barriers from limited affordable units and rising borrowing costs amid high interest rates. Older apartment buildings in Seoul's premium locations, such as Jamsil redevelopment sites, are attracting investor attention for long-term appreciation potential.
sections.International Economy: Kevin Wash is set to assume Fed chair duties on May 22, with his first FOMC meeting scheduled for June 16-17, creating uncertainty over whether rate cuts will occur under his leadership amid Trump's public pressure for lower rates. US housing markets face direct impacts from elevated mortgage rates, with 30-year Treasury yields exceeding 5% and young millennial buyers struggling with affordability and limited inventory. President Trump claimed that protective tariffs on Intel would have made it the world's largest company and suggested similar trade protection approaches moving forward. Middle East conflicts and war duration concerns continue driving oil prices higher, creating inflation pressures that complicate Fed policy decisions. Trade tensions and geopolitical risks dominate international economic outlook with implications for global capital flows and investment strategies.
sections.AI & Economy: A 1 trillion-won industrial growth fund was launched to support AI transformation in manufacturing and innovation-driven company growth, with an additional 700 billion won in preferential financing for R&D-focused industrial firms. Employment impact projections suggest that 62.6% of 182 major occupations will maintain current employment levels through 2035, with AI replacing repetitive tasks rather than entire job categories across medicine, nursing, data analysis, and content creation. Policy experts emphasize selective concentration on globally competitive advanced industries including AI and semiconductors rather than size-based company distinctions, arguing that entire industrial ecosystem growth depends on innovation sector competitiveness. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang expressed optimism that China's AI chip market will eventually open, though US trade representative comments suggest semiconductor export restrictions remain active negotiation items. AI's potential as a second industrial revolution faced public skepticism at university graduations, highlighting potential gaps between industry enthusiasm and broader societal acceptance.
sections.Others: Global investment giants including Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway and Bridgewater Associates expanded big-tech and semiconductor stock positions in the first quarter, reflecting concentrated bets on AI and advanced technology. Lenovo and other Chinese PC and server manufacturers face supply chain uncertainties regarding NVIDIA's H200 chip availability amid US export controls. Deputy Foreign Minister Park is conducting comprehensive reviews of Korea-US security issues including nuclear submarines, capital investment projects, trade law Section 301 investigations, and restrictions on North Korea intelligence sharing. China's structural economic weakness as an energy-importing manufacturing exporter was highlighted in context of historical support from Iran, Venezuela, and Russia at discounted oil prices. Experirics, an AI-based digital identity specialist, reported first-quarter revenue of 6.7 billion won, representing 34.7% year-over-year growth in its specialized market segment.
